title: centaurea alba var. latronum
intro: Centaurea alba var. latronum, commonly known as White Knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents of Centaurea alba var. latronum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
